title: [VSC-27] VS Code on Windows: agent and account terminals assume a PowerShell default shell
description:
Filed by VSC-18 (task-43363b5d) from its adversarial pass (Windows quoting in new terminal commands).
On win32, AgentLauncher and AccountsTreeProvider.runCli call vscode.window.createTerminal with no shellPath, so the line is typed into the user's default profile:
- The agent line starts with `$env:MOE_DAEMON_PATH='...'; powershell ... -EncodedCommand ...`. The bundled extension always sets MOE_DAEMON_PATH, so the line works only when that profile is PowerShell; it fails under Command Prompt, Git Bash and WSL.
- The accounts line `powershell -NoProfile ... -EncodedCommand ...` also fails under a WSL default profile, where only powershell.exe resolves.
VSC-15's QA noted the same. JetBrains chooses its shell explicitly (TerminalAgentLauncher, plus its 'Run Agents in WSL' toggle). Remote-WSL is not affected, because process.platform is linux there. Open question for the planner: pass shellPath 'powershell.exe' on win32, or detect the profile and build the matching line.
definitionOfDone: On win32 an agent launch and an account CLI run work whatever the default terminal profile is (for example, an explicit PowerShell shellPath), pinned by a node:test on the createTerminal options under a win32 platform override.
The -EncodedCommand framing, assertSafeArg and the powershell-quoting and agent-launcher-controls tests stay unchanged and green.
In a git-archive snapshot, moe-vscode `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0.

implementationPlan.description:
1. Tests first (RED): new file moe-vscode/tests/windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs (Write tool).

Phase 0:
- Confirm VSC-25 (task-3c485081) is DONE. Read its landed AccountsTreeProvider.ts:
  - runCli, now reachable from cached-rotation rows while disconnected;
  - text() in place of say();
  - the Q2 quoting-copies test in accounts-actions.test.cjs.
- Re-read this row's comments, including the architect note comment-49c717d6.

Decision on the open question:
- Pass `shellPath: 'powershell.exe'` on win32 at both createTerminal sites. Do not detect the user's profile.
- PowerShell 5.1 is on every Windows PATH (System32), and both lines are PowerShell lines (`$env:...; powershell ... -EncodedCommand ...` and `powershell ... -EncodedCommand ...`).
- Add NO shellArgs. -NoProfile would drop the user's profile, which often puts node and claude on PATH (fnm or nvm init).
- Every other platform, Remote-WSL included (process.platform is linux there), keeps no shellPath at all.

The new test copies its harnesses; tests share no helper module, the house rule:
- The launcher loader and `extension()` helper come from powershell-quoting.test.cjs: run() under vm.createContext, with `process: Object.create(process, { platform: { value } })` and loadClient() for '../services/MoeDaemonClient'.
- The provider is loaded with a closed map ('vscode', '../util/AccountPresentation'). The wrapper function takes a 4th parameter named `process`, shadowing the global, and receives the same platform override.

Cases:
- W1, agent launch:
  - Under win32, `launchAgent('architect', 'claude', ext, ...)` creates one terminal whose options are exactly { name, cwd, shellPath: 'powershell.exe' }. name and cwd are as today. The sent line still starts with `$env:MOE_DAEMON_PATH=` and ends with `-EncodedCommand <base64>`.
  - Under linux, the options have NO shellPath key (`Object.hasOwn`), and the line is the bash form.
- W2, account CLI (the provider with corpus C05; also C09 disconnected, from client-accounts.json):
  - Under win32, signIn on a row creates the terminal with { name: the bundle's moe.accounts.terminal.tab, shellPath: 'powershell.exe' }, and sends exactly `accountsCommandLine(cli, file, ['login', id], true)`.
  - Under linux: no shellPath, and the line built with windows=false.
  - The C09 case covers the disconnected rows VSC-25 added.
- Read the corpus and bundle; never edit them.

RED: run `node --test tests/windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs` in a whole-repo snapshot: `S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc27-red.XXXXXX) && git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S"`, with the new file copied in, from $S/moe-vscode after `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund`. The win32 assertions of W1 and W2 must fail (no shellPath); the linux ones pass.

error handling: each assertion names the case, the platform and the option, so a failure says which site or platform drifted.

2. Implementation (Edit tool only). Do NOT touch psQuote, shQuote, assertSafeArg or the -EncodedCommand framing.

moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts, launchAgent:
- The createTerminal call becomes `vscode.window.createTerminal({ name: terminalName, cwd: workspacePath, ...(isWin ? { shellPath: WINDOWS_SHELL } : {}) })`.
- Use the existing isWin, which already chooses buildPowerShellCommand, so the shell and the line can never disagree.
- Add one module constant `const WINDOWS_SHELL = 'powershell.exe';` with a comment: the line is PowerShell, so it must not depend on the user's default terminal profile (Command Prompt, Git Bash, WSL). No shellArgs, so the profile can still set PATH.

moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts, runCli:
- Compute `const windows = process.platform === 'win32';` once.
- Pass it to accountsCommandLine and use it for `createTerminal({ name: text('moe.accounts.terminal.tab'), ...(windows ? { shellPath: 'powershell.exe' } : {}) })`.
- Keep the clipboard fallback and its message.
- The provider still imports only vscode and AccountPresentation, so no shared constant module; a short comment ties it to AgentLauncher's WINDOWS_SHELL.
- VSC-25's Q2 test holds only the three quoting helpers equal, so this constant does not affect it.

error handling:
- A shellPath VS Code cannot start surfaces exactly as today.
- In AgentLauncher, the existing catch reports 'Failed to launch <role> agent'.
- In the provider, createTerminal is inside a try whose catch copies the line to the clipboard and warns.
- Nothing new can throw.

GREEN:
- In the step-1 snapshot (with the two src files copied in), the new test passes.
- So do accounts-actions, powershell-quoting, agent-launcher-controls, agent-seats, protected-runtime and verified-local-launch. Those check only name and cwd, never the whole options object.

3. Verification, run once and fresh, from the repo root. This is the complete_task evidence, verbatim:
S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc27.XXXXXX) && git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && (cd /mnt/d/projexts/moes && cp --parents moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts moe-vscode/tests/windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs "$S") && cd "$S/moe-vscode" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test && git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes diff --quiet HEAD -- moe-vscode/tests/powershell-quoting.test.cjs moe-vscode/tests/agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs

Before running:
- `git status --short moe-vscode/` must list only this task's three files (mem:gotcha-snapshot-gate-peer-wip-checkpoint).

Expect:
- exit 0, lint 0 and compile 0;
- npm test passes, with the new file's tests counted (record the totals);
- the last check proves DoD 2's pinned tests are unchanged.

If it fails:
- Fix only within the three files and re-run the whole command fresh.

This step adds no error handling of its own.

4. Adversarial self-review (load adversarial-self-review), then complete_task.

Mutants, one at a time in the step-3 snapshot (edit the SNAPSHOT copy; restore each), each run with `node --test tests/windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs`:
- M1: drop the shellPath spread in AgentLauncher → W1 win32 fails.
- M2: set shellPath unconditionally in AgentLauncher → W1 linux fails.
- M3: in runCli, use `windows` for the line but `!windows` for the shellPath → W2 fails on both platforms.
- M4: `shellPath: 'pwsh.exe'` in the provider → W2 win32 fails.
Each kill must be an assertion, never a load error.

Then check:
- Remote-WSL (platform linux) is unchanged.
- The -EncodedCommand framing and the quoting helpers have no diff (VSC-25's Q2 still passes).
- No shellArgs were added.
- Both sites take the same platform decision as their line builder.
- `git diff --numstat` on the three files: under about 150 net lines.
- Note in the summary that JetBrains needs no change: TerminalAgentLauncher types the line its WSL toggle picks into the IDE's local shell widget, whose Windows default is PowerShell. The Windows-default-shell question there is a separate concern, not this row's DoD.

Finish:
- If bytes change, re-run step 3.
- Call complete_task with step 3's command, exitCode and outputTail.
- Report modifiedFiles as exactly the three files.
- The summary carries the test counts, the RED list and the mutant kills.

This step adds no error handling of its own; any failure loops back to step 3.

comments.content:
Planner input from VSC-25 (task-3c485081, plan rev 1, WORKING). This row's reopen reason says "plan the shellPath change against the post-VSC-25 single copy". That assumption no longer holds: after VSC-25, psQuote, shQuote and assertSafeArg remain **two** text-identical copies, in src/util/AgentLauncher.ts and src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts. A new test, accounts-actions.test.cjs Q2, compares their TypeScript AST text, so a change to one must be made to both.

**Why there is no single module.** powershell-quoting.test.cjs and agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs load both files with closed require maps. Your DoD 2 pins those two tests unchanged too, so any new runtime import in either file breaks them.

**For your shellPath change:**
- It touches only the createTerminal options: AgentLauncher's launch, and the provider's runCli. The helpers are not involved.
- After VSC-25, runCli is reachable while disconnected, from cached-rotation rows (corpus C09). Your win32 createTerminal test should cover that path too.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: On win32, the VS Code agent terminal and the Accounts CLI terminal both start powershell.exe explicitly (shellPath), so their PowerShell lines run whatever the user's default terminal profile is. Every other platform, Remote-WSL included, creates its terminals exactly as before.
acceptanceCriteria: Under a win32 override, launchAgent's createTerminal options are exactly { name, cwd, shellPath: 'powershell.exe' } and the line keeps its -EncodedCommand framing. Under linux there is no shellPath key.

Under win32, Accounts sign-in (C05 connected, and C09 disconnected) creates { name: moe.accounts.terminal.tab, shellPath: 'powershell.exe' } and sends accountsCommandLine(..., true). Under linux there is no shellPath, and the bash line is sent.
powershell-quoting.test.cjs and agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs are unchanged and green, and the moe-vscode gate exits 0.
invariants: psQuote, shQuote, assertSafeArg and the -EncodedCommand lines are unchanged.
The provider's runtime imports stay vscode and AccountPresentation.
compatibility: Linux, macOS and Remote-WSL terminals are byte-identical to today.
The clipboard fallback still runs when no terminal can be created.
approvedScope: AgentLauncher.launchAgent's createTerminal options, plus a WINDOWS_SHELL constant.
AccountsTreeProvider.runCli's platform flag and createTerminal options.
reuse: The existing isWin flag and the line builders; the harnesses copied from powershell-quoting.test.cjs and accounts-actions.test.cjs.
sourceAssumptions: AgentLauncher.ts about :405-408: `vscode.window.createTerminal({ name: terminalName, cwd: workspacePath })`, with isWin choosing buildPowerShellCommand at about :383.
AccountsTreeProvider.ts runCli (post-VSC-25): `createTerminal({ name: text('moe.accounts.terminal.tab') })` inside try/catch, with the line built using `process.platform === 'win32'`.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Chosen: an explicit `shellPath: 'powershell.exe'` on win32 at both createTerminal sites, driven by the same platform flag that picks each line's format.

Rejected:
- Detecting the default profile (terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows plus profiles) and building a cmd, Git Bash or WSL line: three more line builders, and their quoting rules multiply the injection surface VSC-2f4b224f just closed.
- Adding shellArgs -NoProfile: users' profiles often set PATH for node or claude.
- pwsh.exe: not installed everywhere, while powershell.exe always is.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- AgentLauncher.launchAgent has one createTerminal ({ name, cwd }) and picks buildPowerShellCommand from isWin.
- After VSC-25, the provider's runCli has one createTerminal ({ name }) inside a try whose catch falls back to the clipboard.
- Existing tests read only options.name and options.cwd (agent-seats, protected-runtime, verified-local-launch, accounts-actions assertTerminal), never the whole object, so adding a key is safe.
- powershell-quoting.test.cjs's loadWindowsLauncher shows the win32 process override for AgentLauncher.
- The provider's loaders use runInThisContext, so the new test shadows `process` through a 4th wrapper parameter.

- This row depends on VSC-25 (task-3c485081, WORKING), which is editing AccountsTreeProvider.ts right now. Build on its landed bytes.
- The DoD pins powershell-quoting and agent-launcher-controls unchanged; the gate's last check proves it.
- VSC-25's Q2 identity test must keep passing: do not touch the quoting copies.
